purpose: Raster logo approval concepts; not applied to application

prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: high-end logo approval board for the existing native live video playback application MIZIN PLAYOUT, for concerts and events, multiple independent Programs and mirrored outputs. Generate ONE polished landscape 1536x1024 brand concept board, labelled A in a small corner. Primary design: an original decisive geometric M monogram made from two continuous angular signal paths, with a subtle forward-play void in negative space. The silhouette must read as M and work at 24 pixels; avoid a generic triangle inside a circle. Style: precise flat vector-like graphic identity, premium professional broadcast/event equipment aesthetic, simple and recognizable, crisp hard edges. Palette: luminous cyan/teal symbol, ice-white typography, deep ink/navy backdrop, with one restrained secondary teal tone only. Layout: large centered horizontal symbol + wordmark on dark background in upper two-thirds; clean white lower strip displaying the identical logo in pure black, the symbol alone, and one small rounded-square desktop app icon. Typography: custom contemporary geometric uppercase sans-serif, confident and spacious, MIZIN above smaller PLAYOUT. Text verbatim ONLY: A, MIZIN, PLAYOUT. Do not invent slogans or other names. Avoid photoreal mockups, shadows, bevels, metallic effects, excessive glow, gradients, circuitry, broadcast antennas, film reels, clutter, brand references, watermarks. This is a fresh original identity exploration, not a reproduction of existing marks. Excellent coherent optical spacing and icon/wordmark proportions. The small examples must faithfully reuse the same central symbol.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: modern logo approval board for MIZIN PLAYOUT, a native professional live video playout application for shows, concerts, independent video Programs and mirrored screens. Generate ONE premium landscape 1536x1024 proposal board labelled B in a small corner. Primary design: an original abstract split-screen portal / forward motion emblem, built from three bold offset rectangular frames with one clean directional opening to the right. It should suggest coordinated screens and a controlled take, architectural and confident, not the letter M and not a generic play triangle. Strong memorable asymmetrical silhouette, restrained geometry, readable small. Flat vector-like artwork, professionally designed optical proportions. Palette: warm coral/vermilion with a single tangerine accent on a deep ink/navy background; ice-white wordmark. Layout: upper two-thirds large centered horizontal logo lockup; lower third clean white strip with faithful pure-black lockup, symbol by itself, and a small rounded-square desktop app icon. Exact wordmark MIZIN in a bold, slightly condensed uppercase bespoke sans-serif, PLAYOUT smaller below, beautifully kerned. Text verbatim ONLY: B, MIZIN, PLAYOUT. No other text, slogans, names, watermark, existing-brand imitation. Avoid 3D, bevels, shadows, metal, photoreal signage, devices, glow, gradients, circuit boards, film reels, antennas, overly complex thin lines. Every example uses the identical original emblem.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: logo approval board for the existing product MIZIN PLAYOUT, native professional media playout software with independent playlists, mirrored and independent outputs for live events. Create ONE premium landscape 1536x1024 board, labelled C in a small corner. Primary design: a distinctive original flowing P emblem constructed from one broad continuous folded ribbon, its open counter elegantly implying a forward-running sequence; one decisive cut gives a subtle second output branch. More fluid and sophisticated than rigid angular M or stacked screen/frame logos. Keep it simple, bold, flat vector-like, readable as an app symbol at 24 px. Palette: saturated electric violet with one restrained aqua accent, ice-white typography, deep ink/navy backdrop. Logo must work in one color, no gradient dependency. Layout: large centered horizontal symbol and MIZIN PLAYOUT wordmark in upper two-thirds; clean white strip below containing the same symbol in pure black, a black horizontal lockup, and a small rounded-square app icon using the original mark. Modern wide uppercase geometric type for MIZIN with generous but controlled spacing; PLAYOUT smaller directly below. Exact text ONLY: C, MIZIN, PLAYOUT. No slogans, new brand names, watermarks, real brand references. Avoid generic play-button circles, film/camera motifs, antennas, circuitry, excessive linework, decorative sci-fi fonts, 3D, bevels, lighting tricks, shadows, mockup photography. Faithful consistent emblem across all samples, beautiful editorial balance and professional craft.
